content.text: {"rows":[{"covenant_id":"min_unrestricted_cash","page":1,"printed_label":"Minimum Unrestricted Cash","actual_printed":"$5,300,000","required_printed":"Not less than $3,000,000","compliance_printed":"Yes"},{"covenant_id":"min_runway_months","page":1,"printed_label":"Minimum Runway","actual_printed":"15.1 months","required_printed":"Not less than 6.0 months","compliance_printed":"Yes"},{"covenant_id":"revenue_vs_plan","page":1,"printed_label":"Revenue to Plan","actual_printed":"105.23%","required_printed":"Not less than 80.00% of plan","compliance_printed":"Yes"}],"scale_statement":"Dollar amounts in this certificate are presented in whole U.S. dollars.","scale_page":1,"notes":["The Schedule 1 calculation of Unrestricted Cash on page two includes cash held in an escrow collateral account opened during the month; escrow collateral cash may not qualify as unrestricted, so the reported cash and runway figures may warrant review.","The requirement for Revenue to Plan on page one wraps across two lines in the summary table."]}
